notablePrerequisites: You have not played a land or cast a spell using Serra Paragon this turn.
description:
Cast Necromancy from your graveyard by paying {2}{B} using Serra Paragon's ability.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Serra Paragon.
Necromancy triggers, returning Composite Golem to the battlefield and becoming an aura attached to it.
Activate Composite Golem's ability to add {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Necromancy goes to the graveyard as a state-based action.
Its ability granted by Serra Paragon triggers.
In response, repeat.
After repeating any number of times, resolve all triggered abilities, gaining 2 life each time.
